newsitem.title: USA: Research buys shares from founder's estate.
newsitem.headline: Research buys shares from founder's estate.

text.p: Research Inc said Wednesday it repurchased 237,519 shares of the company's common stock from Mary Ellen Abramson and the estate of Andrew (Ed) Abramson, a founder of the company, for $6.45 a share.
Research said it has paid half of the purchase price in cash and will pay the remaining amount in early 1998.
After the repurchase, the company has 968,424 shares outstanding.
The company said it bought the shares because a block sale of that size could have significantly depressed the market price of the stock.

"I expect the redemption to have a favorable effect on earnings per share and book value per share, which is consistent with the company's commitment to enhancing shareholder value," Claude Johnson, Research president and chief executive, said in a statement.
Ed Abramsom was a founder of the company and served as chief executive and a director for many years, Research said. He died in June 1996.
Shares of Research, which manufactures industrial electronic controls and radiant heating equipment, closed down 1/4 at 6-1/2.
